preferences: When user asks to clean project, run preview first and explicitly explain MinSizeMB threshold impact before apply.
When user reports remaining size after cleanup, provide top directory size breakdown first, then offer safe second pass.
瘦身默认先预览再执行删除，并回报释放空间和JSON报告路径。
fixes: Default MinSizeMB 20 can miss many 1-20MB build artifacts; run a second scan with MinSizeMB 1 for safe whitelist cleanup when user still needs more space.
After cleanup, explicitly explain that .git and dependency folders such as oh_modules or node_modules are expected remaining size and are not safe-garbage targets by default.
瘦身执行后若释放不足，按规则降阈值二次扫描（例如MinSizeMB从20降到1）并分别汇报两轮结果。
contexts: Workspace is often a Git repo on Windows PowerShell; safe cleanup must keep Git-tracked files untouched.
custom_prompts: 瘦身流程固定：preview -> apply -> 报告路径与释放量核对。
